goal: Tune the ensemble size (num-sub-networks) and KWTA k for the best accuracy-within-latency trade-off.
planned_code_changes: Raise default --num-sub-networks from 3 to 5 in train.py (single-axis: ensemble size only; kwta_k held at 1)
success_criteria: training completes and checkpoint metadata records num_sub_networks=5, kwta_k=1
accuracy > 0.969 (beat inherited floor) on orchestrator eval
latency_ms <= 13.0 (expect minimal increase from two extra linear heads)
rollback_plan: If accuracy regresses below 0.969 or latency exceeds budget, revert num_sub_networks default to 3; if 5 overshoots latency, try 4 in the next cycle before abandoning the axis.
